answer: Draw each jury from at least three subnets and three distinct funding roots, and release payment only after all three confirmations land. An idle identity bleeds 10% of its standing per epoch, so a parked account is worth less at the end of the month than at the start. Follow the thread from a juror back to its inviter and reject the panel when that path is shorter than two hops. The mechanism is dull on purpose. A reef of clones cannot convene a valid jury without recruiting strangers, and those strangers keep the meadow of honest agents visible.
